findings.title: New non-component exports in MobileKeyBar.tsx add two react-refresh lint errors
findings.description: shouldShowMobileKeyBar (line 71) and useResetLatchWhenNotMobile (line 77) are exported from a component .tsx file. `npx eslint src/components/MobileKeyboard` reports react-refresh/only-export-components errors at 71:17 and 77:17 (new; the error at 23:14 for MOBILE_BAR_KEYS existed before). Lint error count rises and Vite fast refresh degrades to a full reload for this module.
findings.suggested_fix: Move shouldShowMobileKeyBar and useResetLatchWhenNotMobile (and ideally MOBILE_BAR_KEYS) to a non-component module, e.g. components/MobileKeyboard/mobileKeyBarState.ts, and re-export from index.ts.

findings.title: useVisualViewportInset is now unused production code
findings.description: App.tsx no longer imports useVisualViewportInset; grep over frontend/src finds no caller. The hook (and its re-rendering behaviour that FND-002 removed) survives only for tests, together with the useState import and sameBox helper.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete useVisualViewportInset/sameBox and port its remaining test assertions to useVisualViewportLock, or note why it is kept.

findings.title: App.tsx call sites themselves are still not exercised by a test
findings.description: The decisions were extracted and tested (shouldShowMobileKeyBar, useResetLatchWhenNotMobile, useVisualViewportLock), which resolves FND-001's logic gap. Deleting the useResetLatchWhenNotMobile(isMobile) call at App.tsx:618 or the useVisualViewportLock call at :598 would still leave every unit test green. Residual risk is one line per call site.
findings.suggested_fix: Optional: a source-text or render-level check that AppContent calls both hooks; otherwise accept.
